en.name: Duck fat
en.summary: Duck fat keeps 30 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below in a clean sealed jar. It is a rendered animal fat, so what ends it is rancidity rather than any microbe — but any meat particles or water left in it will bring that forward.
en.pantry: No room-temperature timeline is published for duck fat, and the jar should not live by the stove. Warmth and light are two of the four drivers of rancidity, along with air and time, and a rendered fat sitting warm will turn far faster than the same jar kept cold. There is also the question of what is in it: home-rendered fat carries meat solids and water from the bird unless you strain it, and those support spoilage in a way clean fat does not. Strain it hot through muslin into a clean jar, let it set, and refrigerate.
en.fridge: 30 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, in a clean jar with a tight lid. Strain the fat while it is still liquid — the dark sediment at the bottom of a jar is meat solids and moisture, and a jar with a layer of it will turn before a clean one. Take it out with a clean dry spoon, never one that has been in a pan, and do not top up an old jar with fresh hot fat. Duck fat also absorbs fridge odours readily, so keep it properly sealed if you want it to taste of duck and not of last night's dinner.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for duck fat. Freezing does work, and for a large batch rendered from a whole bird it is worth doing — cold slows oxidation, which is the only process that actually limits a clean rendered fat. Because there is no published window, judge it by smell rather than by a date you have invented: freeze it in small portions in an airtight container, and if it smells sharp or crayon-like when you take a piece out, it has gone regardless of how long it has been in there.
en.thawing: Take out a frozen portion and drop it straight into a hot pan, or let it soften in the fridge. Do not thaw a whole jar on the counter and refreeze what is left.
spoilage: A sharp, crayon or paint-like smell — rancid fat, and decisive.
A bitter or metallic taste in potatoes fried in it.
Mould on the surface or around the rim, which means the jar goes out.
Water separated out beneath the fat, or a sour smell, from fat that was not strained.
tips: Strain it hot through muslin; meat particles are what shorten its life.
Use a clean dry spoon every time.
Keep it tightly sealed — duck fat takes up fridge smells.
Start a new jar rather than adding fresh fat to old.

faq.q: How long does duck fat keep?
faq.a: 30 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, in a clean sealed jar.
Yes, and it is worth doing for a large batch, but no freezer timeline is published for it. Freeze small portions and judge by smell rather than by a date.

faq.q: Why does my duck fat smell off after only a few weeks?
faq.a: It was probably not strained. Meat solids and water left in the fat support spoilage that clean rendered fat does not, and a warm jar turns faster still.

zh.name: 鴨油
zh.summary: 鴨油裝乾淨密封罐、放 4 °C 以下冷藏可放 30 天。它是熬出來的動物性油脂，終結它的是油耗而不是微生物——但只要裡面殘留肉屑或水分，那一天就會提早到來。
zh.pantry: 鴨油沒有公布的室溫期限，而且那罐油不該住在爐邊。溫度和光是油耗四個推手裡的兩個（另外兩個是空氣和時間），一罐擺在溫暖處的熬製油脂，壞得比冰起來的同一罐快得多。還有「裡面有什麼」的問題：自家熬的油若沒過濾，會帶著鴨肉的碎屑和水分，而那些東西會支持腐敗，乾淨的純油脂則不會。請趁熱用紗布濾進乾淨罐子，凝固後冷藏。
zh.fridge: 裝乾淨、蓋緊的罐子，放 4 °C 以下 30 天。趁還是液體時就過濾——罐底那層深色沉澱是肉屑和水，有這層的罐子一定比乾淨的更早壞。取用要用乾淨的乾湯匙，絕對不要用剛碰過鍋子的那支，也不要把新熬的熱油加進舊罐子。鴨油很會吸冰箱的味道，所以想讓它吃起來像鴨油而不是昨晚的菜，就要確實密封。
zh.freezer: 鴨油沒有公布的冷凍期限。冷凍確實有效，而且如果你一次從整隻鴨熬出一大批，那很值得——低溫能拖慢氧化，而氧化是唯一真正限制乾淨熬製油脂的過程。因為沒有公布的期限，請用氣味判斷，而不是自己編一個日期：分成小份裝密封容器冷凍，取出時如果聞起來刺鼻、有蠟筆味，那就不管放了多久都該丟。
zh.thawing: 拿一份出來直接丟進熱鍋，或放冷藏回軟。不要把整罐放在檯面上解凍、剩下的再凍回去。
spoilage: 聞起來刺鼻、像蠟筆或油漆味——油耗了，而且是決定性的。
用它煎的馬鈴薯帶苦味或金屬味。
表面或罐口長霉，整罐丟掉。
油層下面析出水，或聞起來發酸，那是沒過濾乾淨的結果。
tips: 趁熱用紗布過濾；縮短它壽命的就是那些肉屑。
每次都用乾淨的乾湯匙。
密封好——鴨油很會吸冰箱的味道。
重開一罐，不要把新油加進舊油裡。

faq.a: 裝乾淨密封罐放 4 °C 以下冷藏 30 天。
可以，而且一大批的話很值得，但它沒有公布的冷凍期限。請分小份冷凍，並以氣味而不是日期來判斷。

faq.q: 鴨油為什麼才放幾週就有怪味？
faq.a: 多半是沒過濾。留在油裡的肉屑和水分會支持腐敗，而乾淨的熬製油脂不會；放在溫暖處的話壞得更快。
